ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily at the distal tips and scattered in small mottling clusters, ratio estimated at 20:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigmentation; high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the distal right tip and sparse high-intensity spotting across the medial and distal sections of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the left lobe trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits higher amplitude variations with distinct deep notches at the mid-trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following a parabolic trajectory terminating in tapered, acute-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity circular pixel cluster at the distal right tip; isolated high-contrast circular pixels scattered across the central surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several fine, white horizontal linear marks on the right lobe surface and a single diagonal linear mark on the upper-medial left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle accumulation on the right distal tip and irregular nicks along the trailing edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant textural asymmetry at the fluke tips, with the right tip displaying heavy encrustation compared to the relatively clean left tip.
